label: complementary
rationale: The predicates 'laced' and 'gold_at' describe different aspects of the scene. 'laced' relates to the state of being bound or fastened (specifically, with laces), while 'gold_at' describes the location of a gold item. They represent distinct properties of objects and their relationships. The 'laced' predicate is used in the context of binding a character to an item, while 'gold_at' is used to specify the location of a gold item. These predicates cannot be interchangeable because they describe fundamentally different states. The action contexts further support this by describing actions related to binding (SNOW) and locating/handling gold (WOE). The 'laced' predicate is used to describe the state of being bound, while 'gold_at' is used to describe the location of an item. These predicates are complementary because they describe different aspects of the scene.
